recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. If OO wants Media.bodySite converted to a BodyStructure-based pattern, handle that through a dedicated current-version tracker rather than through FHIR-14144.
issue_request: FHIR-14144 asked to align Media more closely with Observation by adding CarePlan to basedOn, Location to subject, Media.issued, Observation-aligned bodySite definition/description, DeviceComponent to device, decimal duration, and changing occurrence[x] to recorded[x]/created[x].
initial_application: Commit 17a86882a2828780d4c4f2bd3155b8434c7af17f explicitly referenced #14144 and changed source/media/media-spreadsheet.xml for the requested Media elements, including CarePlan, Location, created[x], issued, bodySite wording, DeviceComponent, and decimal duration.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps Media active in the current build. DeviceComponent is commented out of the current resource set, and commit 7fbb1fff1d9f70f28eb68f4d1251aa670bc889bc removed DeviceComponent references from Media and Observation as a build fix. Later bodySite/bodyStructure work such as FHIR-53203 applied to listed OO resources including Observation but did not list Media as a target artifact, so it does not require reinterpreting this STU3 issue as a Media bodyStructure change.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Media spreadsheet already contains the requested alignment surfaces, and the only literal mismatch from the 2017 request, DeviceComponent, is explained by later current-build resource removal rather than an unapplied requirement.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-14145 was applied in the same 2017 Media commit but was later marked Duplicate and deferred to FHIR-15605; it was not decided here.
Later bodySite/bodyStructure work updated listed OO resources including Observation but did not list Media as a target artifact.
